metadata.description: A marketplace of Claude Code plugins for scaffolding projects and driving day-to-day developer tooling

plugins.name: vibe-generate
plugins.description: Scaffold production-ready projects from curated boilerplate templates (Next.js 16, Rust 2024, Spring Boot 4.0)

plugins.name: tmux
plugins.description: Remote-control tmux sessions to drive interactive CLIs by sending keystrokes and scraping pane output

plugins.name: gog
plugins.description: Google Workspace from the terminal: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts, Sheets, and Docs via the gog CLI

plugins.name: docflu
plugins.description: Sync Docusaurus markdown docs to Confluence, Google Docs, or Notion with the docflu CLI

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Create, structure, validate, and package Agent Skills with scripts, references, and assets

plugins.name: production-patterns
plugins.description: Review code against a growing library of production system-design lessons — the failure modes that only appear under concurrency, retries, and timeouts — and design systems from requirements with a compressed system-design primer

plugins.name: hrm
plugins.description: New Era HRM for agents: upload candidate CVs and fetch AI CV reviews and JD match results with a personal API token
